conflicts: The current Mosse-Palais is the post-reunification building, not the lost historic palace. Source roof geometry is retained unchanged.
Classicon is the southEast source parent at Leipziger Platz 9, not Leipziger Platz 8. The two southern gap parents are separately preserved.
Floor and bay subdivisions, materials and colours are bounded procedural interpretations of primary descriptions and licensed external photographs, not surveyed façade measurements.
Unverified corner tenants are not assigned names or logos. Courtyard or hidden infill is not generated. The source-only canopy DEBE3DP5ii5cXk3Q stays open beneath its retained roof.

Live viewer raycasting identified two independently published LP7 source façade strips in front of the main parent: DEBE01YYK0001yp5 and DEBE00YY1Yq0005f. Both remain full source profiles and receive their own bounded window treatment. They are not removed as redundant geometry.
